coordinate_calibration.provenance: CARBON-3C-R3: Abaqus SP02_Modal_V02 is in mm (face-sheet node spans 510 x 515 x 2.9 mm; t/mm^3 and MPa). Experimental source SP02_polymax_retry_260803.unv (PolyMAX set Bravo (1)) originates from the 2026-08-03 retry acquisition; its raw parent is the curated Polytec file SP02_500by500_Glue420_honeycomb_full_scan_retry_260803.unv (METRIC_ABS_(SI)), with identical node IDs and coordinates, so coordinates are in metres. Fixed Polytec frame with the same specimen mounting and shaker convention as SP-13: measured TOP exterior face, no X/Y swap, experimental +x = FE +X and +y = FE +Y, inherited from the accepted SP-13 REAL-1 convention. The centre-to-centre translation is a centred approximation (CENTERED_APPROXIMATION), not a measured edge registration.
